Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: أَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family
And spread for me the cradle of Your generosity
And lead me to the fountains of Your mercy
And settle me in the midst of Your paradise
And do not mark me with rejection from You
And do not deprive me with disappointment from You
And do not punish me for what I have committed
And do not call me to account for what I have earned

Arabic text: وَلَا تُـبْرِزْ مَكْتُوْمِي، وَلَا تَكْشِفْ مَسْتُورِي
Translation: And do not expose my hidden faults, and do not uncover what I have concealed

Arabic text: وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَى مِيزَانِ الْإِنْصَافِ عَمَلِي
Translation: And do not place my deeds on the scale of justice

Arabic text: وَلَا تُعْلِنْ عَلَى عُيُوْنِ الْمَلَاءِ خَبَـرِي
Translation: And do not announce my news before the eyes of creation

Arabic text: أَخْفِ عَنْهُمْ مَا يَكُونُ نَشْرُهُ عَلَيَّ عَارًا
Translation: Hide from them that which would bring shame upon me if revealed

Arabic text: وَاطْوِ عَنْهُمْ مَا يُلْحِقُنِيْ عِنْدَكَ شَنَارًا
Translation: And conceal from them that which would bring disgrace upon me with You
Honor my rank with Your pleasure
And perfect my honor with Your forgiveness
And include me among the companions of the right hand
And direct me along the paths of the secure
And place me among the group of the successful
And through me, inhabit the gatherings of the righteous
Amen, O Lord of the worlds
